name: Andrea
desc:
Andrea is an Adret NPC.

Some time prior to 1233 CE, Andrea died on the Surface and found herself in the [Cathedral of the Interstice](location:cathedral_of_the_interstice).

Now the Adretian woman is scared for her life, as she tries to decide between facing the Trial or remaining in [The City of the Drowned](location:the_city_of_the_drowned).
